Definition: to soil, especially in a moral sense
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be profaned, be defiled, be polluted, be corrupt; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be polluted; 1a2) to be profane, be godless; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to pollute; 1b2) to make profane, make godless, cause to be defiled
